messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired -> PD#INC-4821 • prod-eu-west1 • high 5xx rate on /v1/embeddings (threshold 5% -> 18%). auto-escalation to SRE. link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-4821 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Alert details: triggered at scale, initial signal from edge-gateway (5xx surge). contacting on-call.
bob_sre: acked via PD — I'm on it, pulling logs now.
alice_ops: seeing increased errors in customer telemetry dashboards; noticed failed ingestion jobs for customer: big-retailer-inc (error ~30% of requests). raising FYI to support.
bob_sre: quick check: canary deploy to gateway happened ~8m ago. correlating pods:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n gateway -l app=gateway --sort-by=.metadata.creationTimestamp
# few gateways restarting, one 502 in logs
kubectl logs gateway-az1 -n gateway | tail -n 50
```
logs snippet:
```
ERROR auth-proxy: upstream returned 502 for /v1/embeddings id=abcd1234
WARN kvcache: miss for key=ctx-xyz
```
Looks like auth-proxy upstream timeout + retry amplification.
charlie_pm: any customer-visible timeouts? Do we need a status page update?
bob_sre: client retries are causing fanout; sending quick mitigation: temporarily increase circuit-breaker throttle on gateway and scale auth-proxy horizontally. patching HPA now.
dana_oncall: if you need me to take over in 30m I can come on shift; otherwise will standby.
bob_sre: applied hpa bump + increased 503 circuit threshold for 2 routes. monitoring.
alice_ops: errors dropped from 18% -> 7% over last 3m. big-retailer errors down to 8%. good so far.
incident-bot: PD INC-4821 acknowledged by bob_sre at 1759098782. escalation paused.
charlie_pm: thanks — please flag if we need a status page. I'll draft a short note if impact persists.
bob_sre: follow-up: rolling back gateway canary (deploy id: gw-canary-2026-04-11) as precaution. triggering rollback now.
alice_ops: rollback in progress. customers report restored uploads for sample checks. :white_check_mark:
dana_oncall: taking over monitoring for the rest of shift — bob, please include any open action items.
bob_sre: will open incident ticket and add runbook links + timeline. action items: 1) full rollback verification 2) investigate retry/backoff config 3) postmortem (owner: bob_sre).
charlie_pm: cc: support to prepare proactive outreach if SLA-affected customers >1%.
bob_sre: noted. I'm going to run a deeper trace and collect pprof/log bundles; will post artifacts to incident ticket.
incident-bot: PD INC-4821 status -> monitoring. will auto-close if stable for 30m.
alice_ops: adding a short summary to the internal incident channel once PD closes.
charlie_pm: thanks team. keep updates light here — prefer PD for formal timeline.
dana_oncall: acknowledged handoff. I'm on monitor. :handshake:
